function.name: AudioTools.transcribe
function.description: Transcribe an audio file stored in the VM with the local Parakeet ASR service and return its text to the agent.

vm_path.description: Absolute path of the audio file inside the VM. In API calls, use forward slashes for Windows paths, for example C:/Users/Docker/Desktop/Message.mp3, to avoid Python backslash escape errors.

timestamps.description: Whether to include word timestamps in the transcription response. Defaults to false.
